items.t: Boxlight Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.sum: DULUTH, Ga., November 17, 2026--Boxlight Corporation (Nasdaq: BOXL) ("Boxlight" or the "Company"), a leading provider of interactive technology solutions, today announced the Company’s financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
